description: This file defines the ADOdb Plain Text driver for PHP, including the ADODB_text class extending ADOConnection, which manages reading and querying text-based data. It also includes an ADORecordSet_text class for handling record sets from this driver.

classes.name: ADODB_text
classes.description: The main class implementing a PHP database driver for flat text files, supporting connection, querying, and transaction-like features.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_text
classes.description: A class representing a record set for the text driver, extending a generic record set array handler.

methods.name: RSRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the number of records in the current record set.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns whether any rows were affected; here, always false.

methods.name: PConnect
methods.description: Establish a persistent connection using provided data set.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Connects to a text data array, initializing internal state, and performs type probing.
